m13.text: Krenko, an ambitious goblin, is hired by Mr. Taz in a smoky pub for a Boros heist and given a glowing shiv, and he urges his goblins to bring death to their enemies.
He surveys Sunhome, overhears that the Boros succession has come down to a duel, and sets fires and bombs through the floors to create chaos so he can slip into Vinrenn's chambers.
Inside, Krenko smashes open a detention sphere holding an angel, plucks two of her feathers and falsely screams that she attacked him, so that guards seize her.
He delivers the feather to Taz and receives an Orzhov safebox key, and Taz hints at a further job after calling Krenko the boss of something grand.
